name: LBR Med
description: 7-axis lightweight collaborative robot arm (cobot) certified for integration into medical devices. Available in two variants: LBR Med 7 R800 (7 kg payload, 800 mm reach) and LBR Med 14 R820 (14 kg payload, 820 mm reach). Compliant with IEC 60601-1 (electrical safety) and IEC 62304 (medical software development lifecycle). Features redundant torque sensors in all seven joints enabling safe human-robot collaboration, gravity compensation, manual hand-guiding, and haptic feedback. Powered by KUKA Sunrise Cabinet Med and Sunrise.OS Med (Java-based). Biocompatible and corrosion-resistant surfaces suitable for operating room environments. Used as an OEM component in surgical assistance, diagnostics, radiotherapy, and rehabilitation systems.
